## Summary

Describe the operator-visible change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] No real credentials, account IDs, emails, paths, or diagnostic bundles were added.
- [ ] Automatic routing remains opt-in, or the behavior change is explicitly documented.
- [ ] Credential/RPC/profile changes include a security-boundary test and rollback note.
